semantic_fragments.content: Clause 7.1: ME equipment and ME systems intended for home healthcare environment are simple to use and do not require referencing complex accompanying documents. Usability was evaluated in the Usability test report by an operator whose profile included minimum eight years of education.

Clause 7.3.1: Accompanying documents must indicate that the lay operator or lay responsible organization should contact the manufacturer or manufacturer's representative for: (A) Assistance in setting up, using, or maintaining the ME equipment or ME system when needed; and (D) To report unexpected operation or events. Documents must also include a postal address and either a phone number or web address. All described in chapter 'MANUFACTURE INFORMATION' and 'TROUBLESHOOTING' of the operation guide.

Clause 7.3.2: Accompanying documents must include necessary details for healthcare professional to brief the lay operator or lay responsible organization on contraindications and precautions: precautions regarding changes in performance (in 'MAINTENANCE' chapter), precautions regarding environmental conditions (in 'NOTICE' chapter), and degree of accuracy for measuring function (in 'SPECIFICATIONS' chapter). Equipment is not intended to administer medicinal substances, so related sub-clauses are N/A.

Clause 7.4.1: Instructions for use address hazard nature, likely consequences, and precautions for each warning and SAFETY SIGN. Applicable items include: inhalation or swallowing of small parts (P), potential allergic reactions to accessible materials (P), contact injuries (P), use of unauthorized accessories (P, described in 'NOTICE' chapter), and modification of equipment (P, described in 'NOTICE' chapter). Items related to strangulation due to cables, interconnection to other equipment, and use outside carrying case are N/A.

Clause 7.4.2: Instructions for use describe typical operation time/number of procedures and typical service life of the internal electrical power source, both referenced in chapter '1. BATTERY LOADING' of the operation guide. The equipment uses non-rechargeable internal electrical power source, so behavior during charging is N/A.
